products.title: Hugo Boss Bottled Tonic Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hugo Boss Bottled Tonic Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean, and uplifting men’s fragrance that feels light but masculine. It opens with bright citrus notes like apple, grapefruit, bitter orange, and lemon that give an instant fresh kick. In the middle, warm spices like ginger, cinnamon, and cloves mix with soft geranium to add energy and sharpness. The base settles into smooth woody notes and earthy vetiver, giving the scent a calm, confident finish. It is a refreshing, everyday fragrance for men who like clean, sporty scents.

products.title: Le Labo Vetiver 46 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Vetiver 46 Eau de Parfum is a smoky, dark and woody perfume that targets both males and females. It was designed by a perfumer named Mark Buxton, and it was introduced in 2006. It is not a new green vetiver fragrance. It is serious, warm, and even mysterious. The initial spritz is very smoky and woody, followed by a slow disclosure of the earthy vetiver mixed with incense and light spice. It is naughty, adult, and quite stylish.

products.title: Guerlain  L'Homme Ideal Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Idéal Extrême Eau de Parfum for men is a bold and sophisticated fragrance with a warm and spicy character. It opens with a fresh and nutty combination of almond, pink pepper, and bergamot, followed by a heart of plum, cinnamon, and heliotrope. The base dries down into creamy tobacco, leather, patchouli, and cedar. This EDP is loved for its classy, strong scent and long-lasting performance, perfect for evening or special occasions.

products.title: Dunhill  Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Racing Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh and masculine perfume for men. Launched in 2021, it opens with zesty and fresh top notes of lime, bergamot and ambroxan, followed by spicy and aquatic notes of sea salt, cardamom, neroli and coriander. The base notes of driftwood, ambergris, sandalwood and patchouli give it a warm and woody finish.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blu Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a bold take on a fresh and woody DNA profile consisting of leather, bergamot, and cypress (top notes); geranium and violet leaf (heart notes); and agarwood, patchouli, and musk (base notes) mixed seamlessly into a smooth composition with classic Middle Eastern accords of oud, incense, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toillete for Woman
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau De Toilette Dolce Gabbana is a fresh and iconic floral fruity perfume. It was released in 2001 and designed by perfumer Olivier Cresp. The smell starts with sparkling Sicilian lemon and apple, which provides a fresh and crisp touch with a light woody scent of cedar and bellflower. Then it passes to the soft notes of jasmine, white rose, and bamboo to make it light and feminine. Musk, amber and cedar form the foundation of the clean and smooth finish that is fresh throughout the day.

products.title: Givenchy  Gentleman Society Ambree Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Society Ambrée EDP is an elegant, sensual, and strong perfume for men. Its journey begins with a spicy, rich top note, then smoothly transitions through the floral-woody middle note, and finally ends with the creamy smoky base note. The first puff includes nutmeg, clary sage, and juniper berries, after which orris, narcissus, sandalwood, and vetiver take over, and finally, the tobacco, soft vanilla, and Peru balsam unite in the dried down phase.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Society Eau De Parfum is a classic, contemporary and daring perfume for men, a combination of fresh herbs, delicate flowers and deep wood scents. It starts with piquant cardamom and fragrant sage, then develops to the rich heart of French narcissus and the two vetiver notes from Haiti and Madagascar. The base gets warmer with the combination of creamy vanilla, Palo Santo, and smooth cedar. This perfume is powerful, fashionable, and classy – just right for men who love luxury and have a strong personal style.

products.title: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense by Mugler is a warm, creamy and glowing floral scent made for women who love soft sweetness with power. It opens with smooth coconut and fresh bergamot, which feels sunny and rich. The heart is full of jasmine and jasmine tea, giving a clean, white, floral touch that feels calm and elegant. The base has vanilla, benzoin and cashmere wood, making the perfume feel cozy, creamy and long lasting.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and elegant perfume made for women who love floral scents with a creamy touch. It opens fresh and juicy with citrus fruits and gradually turns into a smooth mix of jasmine, fruits and coconut. The base feels warm and comforting with vanilla and amber, making it ideal for daily wear and unique moments too. It smells classy but is still easy to wear, not heavy at all.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Extrait de Parfum is a rich, bold and graceful unisex fragrance from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances known for its beast-level longivity and projection. It is a find blend of fresh bergamot and fruity pear top, floral rosemary and warm oud heart, and smoky bakhoor and heavy leather base.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Le Parfum is a creamy, sweet, and woody scent made for men who like a bold and tempting fragrance. It opens with fresh pineapple mixed with ginger and a soft hint of iris, giving it a bright yet elegant start. Then the creamy coconut blends with deep wood notes, making the scent warm and slightly tropical. The base is smooth and sensual with tonka bean, sandalwood, amber, and ambergris. It feels sweet, masculine, addictive, and lasts well on skin, perfect for nights out and cooler days.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Tobacco Blaze Eau De Parfum is a daring and dark oriental men’s perfume for those who appreciate strong and profound scents. It starts with a combination of spicy saffron, fresh neroli and light floral notes. As it settles, you can smell sweet apricot, warm amber and woody cedar that gives it richness. The final stage of the fragrance is very powerful and manly with leather, oud and patchouli that give the impression of being smoky, warm and powerful.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Absolu Pour Homme Parfum
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Absolu Pour Homme Parfum is a bold, sweet and creamy men’s fragrance launched in 2024. It opens with a juicy mirabelle note that feels slightly fruity and rich from the start. As it settles, chestnut adds a warm, nutty sweetness which feels smooth and addictive. In the dry down, sandalwood gives a soft woody base that stays on skin for a long time and feels very comforting.

products.title: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Emeer Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Lattafa. It is a classy and modern scent with a nice mix of citrus, woods and spice. The perfume opens fresh with lemon, bergamot, clary sage and juniper berries, giving a cool and clean feeling. As it settles, white tea, sandalwood, cardamom and olibanum bring warmth and smoothness. The dry down has ambergris, cedarwood, cashmeran and patchouli that make it deep, cozy, and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Intense Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet, spicy scent made for both men and women. It opens with a unique combination of saffron and bright bergamot, then develops through a smooth heart of plum liquor and cinnamon to a deep base of amber, tonka bean and benzoin. The perfume is daring but gentle at the same time leaving a warm, cozy vibe which is long-lasting on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Dukhan Eau de Parfum is a creamy oriental scent for men from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Launched in 2025, it combines smoky, spicy and sweet notes that wrap around you like warm air. It begins with the spiciness of pimento and the freshness of mandarin, and then goes to deep incense, labdanum and orange blossom. The base contains soft praline, tobacco, amber and tonka bean which result in a smooth and creamy finish.

products.title: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Delicious Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a bright and citrus scent crafted for women who love sweet, creamy and sparkling fragrances which is launched in 2025 it brings together a combination of zesty lemon and bergamot with smooth vanilla and white flowers at the opening. The middle shines with notes of rum, sugar, orange blossom, honey and whipped cream giving it a delicious dessert like feel. The final notes are caramel, tonka, musk and creamy vanilla wrapping the scent into a long-lasting sweet trail that feels both joyful and addictive.

products.title: Afnan Portrait Revival Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Portrait Revival Eau de Parfum is a new unisex fragrance launched in 2023 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It is an oriental spicy scent that brings a combination of sweet, smoky and warm notes. The fragrance starts with cinnamon, honey, saffron and incense these are the top notes of this fragrance which combine into praline, oat and tonka bean in the middle notes and finally settle into dates, caramel, sandalwood and dark chocolate in the base notes. It is a bold perfume that reflects Middle Eastern luxury with a modern twist.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and charming fragrance for women who love to feel confident and graceful. Launched in 2024, this beautiful scent is like wearing a fruity-floral silk dress that turns heads wherever you go. Supremacy Tapis Rouge blends juicy fruits with soft florals, creating a modern perfume that feels playful yet classy.

A single spray of Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum wraps you in a sweet burst of black cherry and litchi, balanced with white peach and a heart of blooming roses and jasmine. The dry down brings a warm touch of vetiver, cloves, and soft peony, making the scent smooth, clean, and feminine. It’s a lovely daily signature for women who love fruity scents with a floral twist.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum is a bold, aromatic fragrance made for men who love rich, smoky, and spicy scents. This perfume mixes fresh herbs, warm spices, deep resins, and dark woods to create a unique scent that feels powerful and masculine.

Inspired by the mystery of smoky incense burning in a grand hall, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum wraps you in layers of fresh bergamot, spicy oregano, and herbal notes. As it settles, the heart opens with opoponax, warm amber, and labdanum that add a smooth sweetness. Finally, the base brings strong smoky notes, oud, leather, and earthy patchouli that stay on your skin for hours.

If you want to stand out at any party, wedding, or special dinner, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum will make sure you get noticed for your bold and classy taste.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is a classy, warm, and spicy fragrance designed for men who love to stand out. This perfume brings together rich woody notes, fresh spices, and smooth amber to create a bold yet inviting scent.

Launched in 2023, Afnan Turathi Brown smells modern but carries a timeless touch. With every spray, you get a burst of fresh spices, warm amber, and smooth vanilla that lasts all day. It’s perfect for men who want to feel confident and elegant, whether it’s for daily wear or special evenings.

If you enjoy strong, warm perfumes that leave a lasting impression wherever you go, Afnan Turathi Brown Eau de Parfum is worth trying.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Heaven Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and classy fragrance for men who love to feel cool and confident. Inspired by clear blue skies and a fresh breeze, Afnan Supremacy in Heaven brings together citrus and green notes with a smooth woody base.

This fragrance feels like wearing a crisp white shirt on a sunny day, simple yet very sophisticated. With every spray of Afnan Supremacy in Heaven, you get a burst of fresh bergamot and mandarin orange, followed by soothing green tea and black currant. The base of musk and sandalwood keeps it soft, clean, and long-lasting.

Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions when you want to smell fresh, neat, and modern.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Parfum (2024 Launch)
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Parfum is an opulent and luxurious women's perfume that has a warm, creamy, and a bit sweet character. The fragrance starts with gentle spices and a light fruity note that feels soft on the skin. As time goes on, the heart turns to floral and sweet with a creamy caramel note that feels decadent. The base is made up of amber, vanilla, and sandalwood which provide a profound and enduring finish. This fragrance exudes the qualities of elegance, daring, and it is suitable for night time and special occasion use.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz is a modern, fresh, and exquisite fragrance designed for everyone. It perfectly captures the feeling of a cool, gentle breeze on a warm day. Aariz is a scent that feels both sophisticated and comforting, blending bright, happy notes with a soft, clean heart.

Aariz smells like confidence and charm in a bottle. It has a beautiful freshness that makes it easy to wear, while its rich base gives it a character that is hard to forget. It’s the perfect choice for those who want a signature scent that is unique, versatile, and consistently receives compliments. One spray of Aariz makes you feel polished, modern, and ready for anything.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense is a captivating and luxurious unisex fragrance that wraps you in a warm and inviting embrace. This modern scent is a beautiful combination of spicy, sweet, and woody notes, creating an experience that is both comforting and sophisticated. Inspired by the rich heritage of Middle Eastern perfumery, Aariz Intense offers a contemporary twist that is perfect for those who want to make a statement.

Aariz Intense is a fragrance that exudes confidence and charm. It's the perfect accessory for anyone who loves a scent that is both powerful and elegant, leaving a memorable trail wherever you go. A single spray of Arabiyat Prestige Aariz Intense will transport you to a world of modern luxury, filled with warmth and sweetness.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Attar Al Youm Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Attar Al Youm Eau de Parfum is a fabulous and divine fragrance that mixes together floral and oriental notes. It starts off with a vibrant citrus and spice combination, afterwards gradually revealing a delicate heart of rose and jasmine, thus providing a rich and classy feel. The combination of amber and musk in the base gives off a warm and durable finish that lingers on the skin for a long time. This fragrance is for those who appreciate sophisticated, long-lasting perfumes that have the quality of being both modern and elegant.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Roses Vanilla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Rose Vanille Eau de Parfum is an alluring, sweet, and romantic fragrance created for the women who prefer floral and creamy scents. It starts with a fresh lemon note that is light and clean on the skin. A very rich rose note gradually comes into play and feels soft and classy. The base notes of vanilla, white musk, and cedarwood impart warmth, sweetness, and comfort that are close to the skin for a long time.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Ishatar Citrus Oud Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is refreshing and fragrant but still in the wood category, and it is designed for both female and male. It starts with a bright mix of mandarin and cardamom which is blended in a clean and spicy way. While it is getting prepared to settle down, soft jasmine, and woody notes take over, which creates a smooth and classy atmosphere. The base of oud, patchouli, musk, and cedarwood adds richness and longevity. This fragrance feels luxurious, contemporary, and comfortable to wear.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Cranberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a very gentle, fresh, and somewhat sweet perfume among others made for women and men at the same time. First on your skin is a pleasant mix of cranberry, lotus, and freesia that is light and refreshing. After a while, the fragrance becomes creamy and silky with musk, pear, and jasmine in the core. During the last phase, sandalwood and vanilla contribute a warm and soft feeling. This perfume emits a serene, pure, and contemporary aura thus making it suitable for everyday use.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Blueberry Musk Eau de Parfum is a unisex delectable, fruity and soft musky aroma. Fresh, playful, and fruity, it starts with luscious blueberry and blackberry. Gradually, among the fruity and fresh notes, come the elegant and velvety floral notes of freesia, lavender, and rose. The base has a creamy and warm feel of vanilla, raspberry and soft woods. This perfume is characterized by its cosiness, modernity and daily wearability.

products.title: Killian Love don't be Shy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Love Don’t Be Shy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful, and addictive fragrance that feels like a warm hug of soft candy and flowers. This famous perfume is loved by many for its delicious marshmallow and caramel notes that remind you of first love and sweet memories.

Killian Love Don’t Be Shy is perfect for women who want to smell sweet, romantic, and noticeable. One spray is enough to make you feel like you are wearing luxury and joy on your skin. It is a perfume that gets compliments and makes people ask, “What are you wearing?”

products.title: Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is an intense, warm, and truly unforgettable fragrance for men. Inspired by adventure and freedom, this perfume combines the deep warmth of rum with exotic dried fruits, rich spices, and smooth woods. It feels bold yet smooth, giving you a confident vibe that lasts all day.

Killian Straight to Heaven Eau de Parfum is made for men who like to stand out. A splash of this perfume feels like stepping into a world of luxury, strong, stylish, and full of character. Perfect for evening parties, romantic nights, or when you want to feel your absolute best.

products.title: Guerlain Vetiver Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain's Vetiver Parfum is a daring and contemporary interpretation of vetiver. It starts with energetic, spicy green notes and converts into a warm and somewhat dry, smoky, earthy middle note. The base is creamy with a sugar-coated tonka that makes the fragrance warm and inviting. It's suitable for night-time and cold weather, and cut out for men who seek a scent that is both classy and rough.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex perfume made for those who love creamy and deep scents. It starts with a warm mix of saffron, lavender and fresh Italian mandarin that brings brightness and spice together. The heart opens with amberwood, cedar and geranium giving it a woody and slightly floral feel. The base of akigalawood, incense and labdanum adds smoky warmth that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex perfume from the house of Swiss Arabian. The perfume has a very deep Middle Eastern oud style with a slight and soft sweet note. The opening of the fragrance is that of warm saffron, then the main note of strong oud and rose takes over and finally a very rich and creamy base of praline, vanilla and oud.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Man Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Swiss Arabian. It opens with a clean mix of citrus and lavender that feels fresh and energetic from the first spray. As it settles, you can feel the spiciness and the marine notes, which contribute to the fragrance a little depth and a pleasant oceanic feel. The warm, sweet and woody base is formed by the blending of amber, patchouli, and creamy praline notes.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Oud Azraq Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy bold oud scents with sweetness. It opens with a smooth honey note merged with dark agarwood, giving a warm and slightly sweet start. The middle contains spicy cinnamon entwined with rich, creamy vanilla and amber, which is pleasant and comforting. The base comprises patchouli and leather, creating a strong, staying Middle Eastern aura. It feels luxurious, warm and powerful, but still wearable.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shumoukh Al Ghutra Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy leather based fragrance made for men who like strong yet clean scents. It initiates with the fresh and a bit green note of the apple and soft violet along with galbanum. When it becomes stable, the rich leather and dry cedar emerge, giving a masculine and confident air to the fragrance. The base is smooth and warm with vanilla and musk, thus making the scent everlasting and soothing yet still light.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Vanilla Toffee Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and comforting unisex fragrance made for people who love dessert style perfumes. It starts off with a powerful outburst of toffee and coffee that is melted and roasted and it gives a warm and friendly feeling. Meanwhile, the notes of vanilla and walnut, milk and dates become quite smooth and edible. The long lasting and the deep base consists of brown sugar, rich Madagascar vanilla, vanilla caviar, tonka bean, woody notes, benzoin and soft musk.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Tonka Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and sweet unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy deep gourmand scents. The opening is slightly sweet with a creamy feeling coming from the soft, nutty almond note. Then, the floral notes of the Tunisian orange blossom and Turkish rose come together with the warm cinnamon in a smooth and cozy heart of the fragrance. The dry down is where the magic stays, with tonka bean, vanilla and amberwood creating a long lasting, addictive scent trail.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Shagaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Swiss Arabian Shaghaf Oud Royal Eau de Parfum is a unisex scent that brings together the luxuriousness of oud and warm, spicy fragrances. Launched in 2023, it starts with a note of glamorous saffron and fresh lavender, then a heart of strong oud and nutmeg, all resting on an attractive base of patchouli and musk.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a deep, elegant, and modern fragrance for men who like to stand out without trying too hard. Intenso Pour Homme is all about pure instinct, a strong, masculine scent that balances rich, woody notes with fresh green touches.

This fragrance opens with fresh basil and watery notes that feel clean and sharp. In the heart, a unique blend of lavender, tobacco, and hay gives Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme a warm and slightly sweet feel. The base is where it gets deep and classy, with sandalwood, amber, labdanum, and musk giving a strong, long-lasting finish.

Dolce & Gabbana Intenso Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is perfect for the modern Indian man who wants to feel confident, sophisticated, and ready to leave a strong impression wherever he goes.

products.title: Kayali Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a playful and sweet perfume that resembles a candy shop visit. The fragrance opens with a combination of creamy vanilla, juicy pear, and soft marshmallow, which gives the scent a warm sugary start. Soon the fragrance becomes even sweeter with the addition of bubble gum, jelly bean, and caramel, making it taste yummy and young. The base turns warm and comfortable with sugar, tonka, patchouli, and soft woods that linger on the skin for a long time. It is a great choice for people who are into sweet, girlish, and cozy fragrances.

products.title: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 is a sweet, creamy, and playful scent that is reminiscent of cold pistachio ice cream on a hot summer day. The fragrance starts with a nutty mix of pistachio, hazelnut, and a soft, cold ice-cream vibe that appeals and tempts. Then it proceeds to a fruity floral heart where jasmine, white peach, and pear are the main contributors and they deliver smooth and fresh sweetness. The last layer consists of whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, and cacao, which gives the skin a warm, sweet, and cozy feel. It’s a happy gourmand scent for anyone whose taste in perfumes swings to the side of creamy, sweet, and dessert-like ones.

products.title: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum feels like a quiet walk in nature on a fresh morning. It opens with the lively brightness of Grapefruit, giving a burst of energy that feels crisp and light. The scent slowly moves into the green heart of Mate, which adds a calm, earthy tone that feels warm and slightly smoky. The final note is woody and grounded, leaving behind a nice and clean trail of timeless fragrance. It is a perfect fit for someone looking for a gentle yet expressive fragrance. It gives off a fresh and outdoor-like feel, and is apt to wear at any occasion at any time of the day.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Kouros Eau de Toilette is a powerful and timeless scent for men that projects an image of boldness, cleanliness, and strength. It starts with a crisp and fresh odor that is very cheerful and somewhat spicy, then gradually changes to warmth and depth. The combination of herbs, flowers, and animalic notes gives it a very masculine and assured character. This fragrance is a classic, heavy, and best suited for the men who appreciate strong perfumes.

products.title: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Mandarino di Amalfi Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and relaxing unisex fragrance inspired by the Italian coast. The fragrance feels very natural, sunny and clean on the skin. The very beginning of the fragrance is dominated by succulent citruses and green herbs, that is, crispness and cheerfulness. The middle notes present a mild floral and spicy aspect, whereas the base remains muted, warm and musky.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Extradose Parfum
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born in Roma Extradose Parfum is a powerful women's perfume characterised by sweetness, richness, and addictiveness. It starts with a blackcurrant note that resembles a fruity and velvety wine and then proceeds to a rum heart that makes the scent dark and elegant. The vanilla base feels like a mixture of cream, sugar, and skin; it is soft, sweet, and persistent. The scent of this perfume conveys an image that is bold, contemporary, and sensual, ideal for women who adore strong and sweet perfumes.

products.title: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Extradose Parfum
products.body_html: Valentino Uomo Born in Roma Extradose Parfum is a masculine fragrance that is heavy, spicy, and woody and is characterized by a bold and modern attitude. The composition starts with very strong and dazzling spicy notes and later gently transitions to wild lavender which contributes a fresh and aromatic facet. The dry down contains mellow woody notes that are very persistent on skin. This fragrance is self-assured, virile, and dramatic, suitable for men who prefer strong and fashionable perfumes.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau de Toilette is a cheerful, fresh, fun and lively women’s fragrance that literally encapsulates summer. Light Blue opens bright and transparent with a shocking burst of Sicilian lemon, Granny Smith apple, cedar, and soft bellflower akin to the scent of an early cool morning soft breeze; incredibly pleasant! Light Blue has a slight playful nature, while bamboo, jasmine, and rose enhance its buoyancy and elegance. Light Blue dries down smooth and enjoyable with cedarwood, clean musk, and a gentle bit of amber, leaving a subtle but long-lasting impression on your skin.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum is the scent of modern confidence. It is a bold, magnetic, and deeply expressive fragrance for the man who is unapologetically himself. This perfume captures a powerful and sophisticated feeling, combining a fresh, spicy kick with a warm heart.

Myslf Le Parfum smells like pure charm and character. It is smooth, inviting, and has a touch of mystery, making it perfect for the man who wants to make a memorable statement without saying a word. A few sprays of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Le Parfum will boost your confidence and leave an unforgettable impression of modern elegance.

products.title: Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Reasons Eau de Parfum is a deep, modern, and soulful fragrance that invites you on a journey of discovery. It’s more than just a scent; it’s an experience. Crafted for the confident individual, this perfume mix of warm spices, rich woods, and a hint of nutty sweetness to create a truly unforgettable aroma.

Reasons smell like finding comfort in sophistication. It wraps you in a warm, elegant embrace that is both powerful and peaceful. This fragrance is perfect for those who want a signature scent that tells a story of wisdom, confidence, and quiet strength. With Amouage Reasons, you don’t just enter a room, you bring a unique and captivating presence with you.

products.title: Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum is a radiant and sophisticated unisex fragrance that feels like liquid sunshine on the skin. A modern masterpiece from the House of Amouage, this scent is designed to evoke a sense of pure elegance and a radiant aura. It beautifully balances warm spices, soft florals, and creamy woods to create a fragrance that is both comforting and captivating.

Amouage Lustre smells incredibly luxurious yet is easy to wear. It has a rich depth and a warm glow that makes you feel special and confident. It’s the perfect choice for those who love modern, elegant fragrances that leave a lasting, memorable impression. One spray of Amouage Lustre will wrap you in a golden embrace, making you feel polished and effortlessly chic.

products.title: Chloe Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chloe Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum is a elegant perfume for women. It was launched in 2024 it is an oriental floral fragrance that combines spicy, floral and warm notes into a smooth and captivating scent. It start with myrrh, cinnamon and ginger followed by the middle notes of orange blossom, Kyphi and broom and settles on a warm base of vanilla, opoponax and cypriol oil. This fragrance is perfect for evening wear and special occasions offering a adventurous aura.

products.title: Hermes Voyage d'Hermes Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hermes Voyage d’Hermes Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and soft woody fragrance for both men and women. It opens bright with cardamom, lemon and light spices that feel lively and uplifting, then moves into smooth tea notes with green and floral touches that add a calm feeling. The dry down is warm and gentle with woods, musk and cedar, giving a soft, cosy finish. It feels elegant, simple, and easy to wear for daily life, perfect for people who like a clean, refreshing scent that still feels classy.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum is a new and elegant women’s fragrance that gives off a clean, fruity, and slightly floral vibe. It starts with a vivid combination of apple and black currant that feels juicy and fresh. Gradually, the perfume develops its floral note with rose and jasmine that feel classy and silky. The base notes consist of musk and soft woods, which are clean and comforting. This perfume seems to be chic, contemporary, and suitable for daily use.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Iconic Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Blue Iconic Eau de Parfum is a fragrance for men that gives a combination of fresh, spicy and woody notes which was launched in 2022 it opens with a bright and zesty combination of grapefruit, lemon, mint, pink pepper and coriander. The middle notes are ginger, melon, nutmeg and jasmine adding a warm yet fresh touch. In the end you will find woody notes, incense, sandalwood, amber, cedar, patchouli and labdanum which together create a masculine finish.

products.title: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Ventana Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. Launched in 2017, it is a fresh yet deep scent that combines citrus and woody tones beautifully. The perfume opens with a shot of grapefruit, lemon, and mandarin orange. The middle brings calming lavender, geranium, vetiver, and patchouli, while the base settles into amber, sandalwood, cedar, and precious woods. It is a bold, energetic fragrance that gives a classy vibe for all-day wear.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey White Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the popular house of Armaf it starts with spicy pink pepper, citrus yuzu and fresh grapefruit that give an energetic start and in the middle violet leaf and sea notes add a soft, clean and slightly green touch. The end notes are warm and woody with amber, amberwood and guaiac wood making it a balanced everyday perfume. It feels refreshing, youthful and modern perfect for men who like a combination of freshness with warmth.

products.title: Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Armaf Legesi Eau de Parfum is the signature scent for the modern man who is confident, sharp, and successful. This fresh and elegant fragrance is designed to make you feel clean and put-together from morning meetings to evening outings. It captures a timeless, classic
charm with a modern twist, making it the perfect everyday companion.Legesi smells incredibly sophisticated and clean. It’s a scent that draws compliments without being loud, creating an aura of professionalism and class. A spray of Armaf Legesi is like putting on a freshly ironed white shirt and a perfectly tailored blazer, it completes your look and prepares you to conquer the day with style.

products.title: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. It carries a strong woody spicy DNA that combines fresh citrus and spicy notes with warm woody accords. The opening comes alive with grapefruit, lemon, bergamot, and pink pepper, leading into a spicy heart of ginger, mint, lavender, and nutmeg. The scent finishes with earthy and deep base notes of vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, and cedar. The combination is modern, youthful, and designed for men who enjoy energy and confidence in their fragrance.

products.title: Lalique Encre Noir A L'Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lalique Encre Noir A L'Extreme EDP is a dark, and woody perfume for a man. It's a composition that starts with clean and cool scents of cypress, elemi, and bergamot, then it goes to a very deep and smoky heart made of Haitian vetiver, vetiver, incense, and orris. The dry down is characterised by warmth and sensuality from benzoin, sandalwood, and patchouli. This scent is considered very attractive because of its striking and splendid smell, thus it is very suitable for nighttime and important events.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Fire Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern unisex fragrance from Rasasi. Launched in 2025, it is an aromatic aquatic scent that combines natural green and floral tones with warm and deep base notes. The fragrance's opening is very relaxed with fresh Clary Sage, then Egyptian Jasmine and Marine notes blossom in the middle and finally, Amber, Mineral notes and Ambergris compose a warm base.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses is a unisex fresh floriantel Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It has a vibrant open of zesty lemon balanced by floral peony lavender and turkish rose, a heart of warm sandalwood, frankincense and white flowers and a musky-amber base mixed with oud, oakmoss, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Frost Ice Eau de Parfum was launched in 2024 as a light and breezy unisex fragrance with refreshing citrus, bergamot, and mint top notes; aromatic spices, lavender, and geranium heart notes; and soft and warm musk, woods, and amber base notes. A couple of spritz of Frose Ice EDP in the morning keeps you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Couture Noir Eau de Parfum is an affordable, luxurious, and unisex signature perfume from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. It is an interesting take on modern citrusy and crispy fruity notes of lemon and apple with warmer and heavier leather, patchouli, amber, and musk with a bit of nature-based accords of lily of the valley and oakmoss.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Muzn is a unisex fruity-aquatic Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It is a vibrant Middle Eastern summer captured in a blend of scents. The playful fruity notes of melon and fruits mixed with sea salt give it its iconic flavor. The musky heart with sandalwood and amber at the base gives it a smooth and lingering drydown.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum is a bold and fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2024 by Lattafa Perfumes, it blends unique spicy, floral, and sweet notes into a smooth, long-lasting scent. The top notes of lavender and black pepper give a fresh and spicy start. The heart notes of coconut water, iris, and salt make it clean and calming. Finally, the base notes of vanilla and incense leave a warm and slightly sweet trail that lasts all day.

products.title: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum is a bold and warm oriental fragrance made for men who like strong and sweet scents. It opens with a fruity and spicy mix that feels rich and energetic. Then, the wood and earth notes take over, creating an atmosphere of depth and masculinity. The final notes are a mixture of creaminess, sweetness and slight hints of gourmand, making Rasasi Entebaa a perfume that is very much alive and noticeable for a long period.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette is a lovely, elegant, and somewhat enigmatic fragrance for women that is reminiscent of creamy flowers. It begins with a spicy mix of pepper, cardamom, and ginger, which is fresh yet warm at the same time. It gradually transitions to a delicate floral heart where gardenia and orange blossom are rich and ladies-like. The combination of sandalwood, musk, and amber at the base provides a warm and clean finish, which is very close to the skin and feels very classy.

products.title: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Crivelli Oud Stallion Extrait de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex scent that mixes deep oud with warm spices and soft floral notes. The perfume opens with spicy hits of saffron, cardamom and Indonesian nutmeg. Then, the heart slowly turns into a floral combination of jasmine, osmanthus and Turkish rose. At the base, it settles into a dark and warm mix of agarwood (oud), leather, cedar, tonka and patchouli, giving it a strong and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is a bright, lively, and feminine fragrance that feels like a fresh morning in a blooming English garden. It’s playful yet elegant, the perfect mix for women who love feeling confident, happy, and graceful.

Created by the world-famous perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this scent opens with the sparkling freshness of pomegranate and lemon, bringing an instant burst of energy. The heart unfolds with green apple, delicate rose petals, and soft geranium, adding a romantic, floral sweetness. Finally, it settles into a dreamy base of wisteria and jasmine, leaving a soft, lingering trail that feels fresh all day.

Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is like wearing your favourite floral dress on a sunny day, uplifting, elegant, and effortlessly charming.

products.title: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Heritage Eau de Parfum is an iconic fragrance for men with a woody-spicy character. It starts with a fresh and powdery note, then leads to a warm, spicy heart and finally ends on a dry woody note. It has the sophistication of the past, a hint of vintage, and is perfect for occasions when a self-assured, classic scent is desired.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Platine Prive Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain L’Homme Idéal Platine Privé Eau de Toilette is a modern and stylish fragrance for men. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of grapefruit and bergamot, moves into a soft and elegant heart of green almond and neroli, and finishes with a warm and masculine base of musk and vetiver. This perfume is perfect for confident men who like a clean, refined, and classy scent.

products.title: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is made for men, but at the same time, fresh, cool, and warm. A bright and cheerful combination comes from opening notes of mint, lime, and rum, with the latter being very delicate. The middle notes containing flowers make the scent softer and more comfortable to be around. Woods of vetiver, cedar, and patchouli in the base result in a warm, earthy, and very intimate finish. This is a no-fuss but elegant perfume that is suitable for everyday and night use.

products.title: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Habit Rouge Eau de Toilette, a quintessentially oriental woody perfume for men, introduces its presence with the brightness of citrus and spices, then relaxes into the warmth of leather and vanilla. It has a character that is both timeless, luxurious, and slightly daring at the same time, thereby being suitable for men who prefer mature and assertive scents. It was the work of Jean-Paul Guerlain in 1988 and is still appreciated for its opulent and sophisticated character.

products.title: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain Vetiver Eau de Toilette is a clean, fresh, and classic men’s perfume with a bright citrus start, warm spices, and earthy woody notes that stay smooth on the skin. It opens with bergamot, lemon, nutmeg, neroli, coriander, tobacco, and mandarin orange, followed by middle notes of vetiver, pepper, carnation, sage, sandalwood, and orris root. The scent dries down to vetiver, oakmoss, leather, tonka bean, amber, civet, and myrrh, giving a natural and timeless feel.

products.title: Burberry London Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Burberry London Eau de Toilette for Men is the perfect combination of British charm and timeless elegance. This fragrance captures the spirit of London, warm, classy, and effortlessly stylish. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and lavender, wrapped in the comforting spice of cinnamon. As it settles, rich leather and soft mimosa create a smooth, masculine heart, leading to a deep base of tobacco leaf, guaiac wood, oakmoss, and opoponax.

Burberry London Eau de Toilette feels like stepping into a cosy, high-end London gentleman’s club warm wood, leather chairs, and a touch of tobacco in the air. It’s sophisticated yet approachable, making it perfect for men who want to stand out with elegance.

products.title: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro White Eau de Parfum is a stylish and modern scent made for confident men. Launched in 2024, it opens with a clean, fresh touch of Juniper Berries, Iris and Cypress, which give it a cool and classy start. The middle adds Myrrh and Patchouli which offer a smooth and deep warmth. And the base combination of Honey, Vanilla, Amber, Musk and Leather provides a strong, masculine and comforting finish.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Red Eau de Parfum is a bold and energetic perfume for men. Launched in 2020, it opens with fresh and fruity top notes of apple, lavender and bergamot. The combination of juicy watermelon, warm cedar and spicy calamus, while the base gives a rich finish with amber, sandalwood and patchouli. It is a modern scent that balances fruity freshness with woody warmth, perfect for everyday wear or special occasions.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and woody scent made for men who like strong but clean fragrance. It opens with sweet notes of vanilla, saffron and jasmine that give a soft and rich start. In the heart, you get lavender, amberwood, green leaves and cedar that make it calm, smooth, and classy. The dry down is deep and earthy with violet, fir resin and cedar that stay warm on skin for hours.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance that mixes freshness with deep woody warmth. It opens with a burst of fruity notes, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple that give a clean and bright start. The nature of the scent turns richer with pepper, birch, patchouli, jasmine, lavender and rose, adding spice and class. In the end, musk, amber and vanilla create a smooth and comforting base that lasts long.

products.title: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Franck Olivier Night Touch Eau De Toilette is really smooth, and nice. It smells fresh, warm, and kinda mysterious all at the same time. When you first spray Night Touch, you get a bright smell of bergamot, pineapple, and cardamom - that’s a clean and energetic start. After a bit, you smell flowery and spicy stuff like geranium, nutmeg, and violet that makes Night Touch nice and balanced. The last smell you get is a rich, manly one with patchouli, musk, and amber that stays softly on your skin for a long time.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette is a stylish and fresh perfume for men, perfect for daily wear or casual evenings. It opens with fresh citrusy and aromatic notes, then moves into a smooth almond and tonka bean heart, finishing with a warm and masculine base of leather, cedar, and vetiver. It is loved by men for its balanced and long-lasting scent that feels natural yet sophisticated.

products.title: Guerlain L'Homme Ideal L'Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Homme Idéal L'Intense Eau de Parfum for men is a bold and intense fragrance with a perfect mix of spicy, woody, and sweet notes. It opens with sharp almond, chili pepper, and cardamom, followed by rich leather, Bulgarian rose, and labdanum in the heart. The dry-down is warm and comforting with smoke, tonka bean, vanilla, sandalwood, and patchouli. It’s highly praised for its long-lasting performance and elegant, masculine aura.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Sandalwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sandalwood by Ibraheem Al Qurashi is a warm, soft, and slightly sweet Oriental Floral perfume that suits both women and men. It opens with a juicy combination of raspberry and deep damask rose, creamy and smooth. The middle adds a powdery touch, combined with dry cedarwood, giving the scent a calm, elegant feel. The base is creamy, warm, and comforting with amber and strong sandalwood that stays long and feels very cosy. It is a simple, classy, and relaxing perfume loved by many who enjoy soft woody scents.

products.title: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Dark Leather Eau de Parfum is an intense, spicy, and daring fragrance for men that primarily conveys the aroma of powerful leather. The scent starts with a pungent combination of black pepper and nutmeg that gives the impression of heat and vigor. In a while, sweet cinnamon, and incense start to unfold, thereby making the fragrance deep and powerful. The foundation of leather and tobacco is a bit harsh, manly, and everlasting. This perfume is an impression of strength, confidence, and it is meant for men who prefer dusky, strong fragrances.

products.title: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Orto Parisi Bergamask Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that mixes fresh citrus with soft florals and warm woods. The fragrance was introduced in 2014 and its initial notes are bright and sharp with bergamot and lemon, then it goes into the floral note of lavender, orange blossom and lily of the valley and finally to a warm musk, cedar and tonka.

products.title: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Acqua di Parma Oud Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It was launched in 2019 by the luxury brand Acqua di Parma, known for classy Italian scents. It opens with fresh orange and Calabrian bergamot, giving a clean citrus start. Then, amyris and coriander bring a warm woody spice. In the base, leather, sandalwood, cedar, musk and patchouli create a deep, smooth and long lasting finish.

products.title: Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense is a bold, addictive, and modern fragrance made for women who love making a statement without saying a word. It opens with the luscious sweetness of ripe strawberries and juicy blackberries, fresh yet indulgent. The heart blooms with creamy jasmine, adding a soft, feminine touch. As it settles, the warmth of vanilla, amber, and sandalwood wraps around you like a cosy, luxurious blanket.

The perfume feels playful yet elegant, perfect for those moments when you want to feel glamorous, confident, and unforgettable. Whether it’s a romantic date night, a party, or a festive gathering, Burberry Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense leaves a trail that turns heads.

products.title: Xerjoff Torino 21 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Torino 21 is a vibrant and nature-friendly perfume that exudes a clean, sharp, and energizing vibe. It starts with lemon and mint, which are both zesty and refreshing, to awaken the senses and to make them feel cool and full of energy. The next step comprises smooth and aromatic lavender, jasmine, and rosemary which are blended together and they share their calmness and fragrance with each other. The musk and vervain combination at the bottom gives a gentle and lasting, therefore, very nice to stay on the skin for hours freshness. Modern, cheerful, and unisex, this scent is nothing but perfect for the ones who adore the crisp, green, and bold perfumes.

products.title: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilio The Hedonist Extrait de Parfum is a strong woody scent made for both men and women. The scent was made by Jordi Fernández in 2024. The top notes are grapefruit, some spicy ginger, and bright bergamot. The middle note mixes Akigalawood, juicy lychee, and cedarwood, which gives it a warm, rich feel. The base rests on soft amberwood, dirt-like vetiver, patchouli, and smooth tonka bean, so the smell lasts a long time and feels totally balanced.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum is a truly confident and lively fragrance – it’s a natural scent. Viper Green is elegant and fully audacious at the same time and is a great fit for a person who likes the cool contrast of feeling fresh but warm at the same time. The scent has that luxury clean aspect, but that unique green bite, distinguishes it from the other standard citrus or floral fragrances out there. That specific citrus in woods helps Viper Green enact a niche in greater appeal with people who desire sophistication, but also differentiate it from traditional fragrance to one that exhibits an edge.

products.title: Prada L'Homme Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada L’Homme Intense Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and deep men’s fragrance at the same time. The fragrance opens with a loud iris note that is clean, powdery, and elegant at the same time. Intense warmth from amber and patchouli slowly comes in and gives the fragrance a rich and slightly dark vibe. The base of leather, tonka bean, and sandalwood makes it creamy, woody, and long-lasting. This fragrance exudes maturity, confidence, and is perfect for men who appreciate strong yet clean scents.

products.title: Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lacoste L.12.12 White is a pure, refreshing, and laid-back scent that was created for men who prefer to wear something that is simple yet elegant. The opening is very fresh and consists of grapefruit blended with spicy notes, which is very lively and sporty. The fragrance softens with time and the light floral notes participate in making the whole aroma even smoother and more balanced. The drydown features a combination of wood and light leather that forms a clean masculine finish which is very tranquil, refreshing, and inviting throughout the day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Cobalt Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance launched in 2024. It takes the original Bad Boy DNA and makes it darker, richer, and more powerful. The scent opens with sharp black pepper and aromatic sage for a spicy and herbal kick. At the middle notes, you find rare truffle and smooth woody notes adding depth. The dry down has warm vanilla mixed with smoky frankincense, giving a strong and lasting impression. This is a fragrance made for men who like confidence, elegance, and strength in one bottle.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Althair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Althair is a warmly sweet and creamy male scent, and it is characterised by a rich vanilla touch. It opens up with spicy cinnamon and cardamom blended with delicate orange blossom and fresh bergamot. Gradually, the fragrance develops into a smooth and sweet combination of bourbon vanilla and a slight resin feel. The foundation reveals a warm and woody depth with praline, tonka, and soft woods. This fragrance is classy, contemporary, and very soothing, which is just right for a confident man.

products.title: Guerlain L'Instant Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain L'Instant Homme EDP for men is a warm and elegant fragrance with a perfect mix of woody and spicy notes. It opens with a fresh and slightly citrusy kick of bergamot, lemon, and star anise. The middle adds richness with cacao pod, tea, sandalwood, smoke, and jasmine, and it settles on a deep patchouli base. This fragrance is loved for its classy and sophisticated aroma that is perfect for evenings and special occasions.

products.title: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Man Eau Fraiche Eau de Toilette is a men's fragrance that is fresh and clean, light, cool, and classy at the same time. Citrus freshness that is very sharp and refreshing is the first thing that you notice when you spray it. After some time, a little bit of soft spicy and herbal notes get revealed and create a very nice balancing act. In the end, a gentle touch of woody and musky notes is almost imperceptibly close to the skin but still exudes a calm and masculine aura. This fragrance is an excellent choice for everyday use, for the office, and in hot climates.

products.title: Mancera  Tonka Cola Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Tonka Cola Eau de Parfum is a playful and warm unisex scent that mixes sweet, spicy and fizzy notes in a very fun way. The scent opens with a lively and spicy start of cinnamon, cherry, lemon and nutmeg. The middle has the effect of cola with a combination of patchouli and soft orange blossom. The aroma at the end is a combination of pleasant tonka bean, vanilla, benzoin and labdanum, leaving a soft and sweet trail that feels warm on skin.

products.title: Neesh Luxe Aoud Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Luxe Aoud Extrait De Parfum from the house of Neesh Perfumes is a rich and deep unisex perfume made for people who love strong oud scents. The opening reveals a spiced, dark and floral fragrance that is warm and bold at the same time. As the perfume goes along, smoky incense with delicate flowers appears gradually. The base is composed of heavy oud, thick wood and musk that remains in your presence long and seriously.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Virgin Island Water Eau de Parfum is a bright and tropical unisex perfume that captures the fresh breeze of the Caribbean islands. The creators, Olivier Creed and Erwin Creed, introduced this perfume in 2007. With lime, coconut, and rum being the primary notes of this scent, it takes you to a sunny beach in an instant. The smoothness and refreshing of the holiday mood that this fragrance brings can be enjoyed by anyone who loves to smell beachy and feel-good scents.

products.title: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau De Parfum is a feminine scent that was launched in 2020 by the Ajmal fragrance house based in the UAE as a vibrant and graceful fruity floral scent with a musk base that gives a creamy and soft drydown. It opens like a zesty fruit bowl on a warm summer day with its apple, pear, bergamot, red fruits, and mandarin orange; develops to the grace of a bouquet of rose, orange blossom, peony, osmanthus, and jasmine; and a soft drydown of a musky base with oakmoss, cedar, vanilla and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Franck Olivier Pure Addiction Eau De Parfum is a really smooth, warm, and mysterious smell. It feels modern but also comforting, you know? It starts with a soft, fresh burst of orange, that gives Pure Addiction a clean and welcoming start. After a bit, you smell saffron, marigold, and jasmine. This adds a spicy, flowery touch that feels elegant and kind of addictive at the same time. The base smells are white amber, praline, moss, and white cedar. This gives Pure Addiction its rich depth. The creamy sweet of praline mixes perfectly with the wood and musk. 

This makes the scent cozy, sexy, and great for both guys and girls. Pure Addiction has that classy balance of sweet and warm that never smells too strong. Pure Addiction is a smell that slowly gets better on you. It's fresh first, then deep and smooth later. Franck Olivier Pure Addiction is perfect for people who like a sweet perfume but want a bit of edge and warmth too.

products.title: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Icon Eau de Parfum is a classy and timeless perfume for men that combines modern freshness with warm woods. Launched in 2015, it brings together citrusy top notes of neroli and bergamot, followed by a spicy core of black pepper, lavender and cardamom. The base is creamy and masculine with vetiver, oakmoss, leather, iris and oud. It’s a perfume that wraps around you a feeling of elegance, confidence and being dressed up throughout the day.

products.title: Valentino Born in Roma The Gold Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Valentino Born in Roma The Gold Eau de Toilette is a contemporary and sophisticated fragrance for men that has a warm woody essence. The initial notes are composed of bright solar and spicy ones which give the perfume a fresh and lively character. A nutmeg note brings in a delicate spicy warmth, while cedar in the heart note adds a clean woody character. In the base notes, vanilla and amber combine to make the fragrance soft, warm, and soothing. This perfume is a reflection of the wearer’s style, self-assurance, and suitability for everyday use.

products.title: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy and light fragrance made for both men and women. The fragrance is a combination of aldehydes with frangipani, jasmine sambac, and iris floral notes, giving the impression of a fresh night breeze. The base of the scent is composed of cashmeran, ambergris, and musk, which are warm notes that stay close to the skin.

products.title: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9AM Dive Eau de Parfum is a fresh aquatic fragrance for both men and women that was Launched in 2022 it brings a cooling and energising feel that is perfect for warm days. The perfume starts with bright lemon, mint, black currant and pink pepper (top notes). In the middle, it turns smooth with apple, cedar and incense. The base carries ginger, sandalwood, patchouli and jasmine creating a balanced, refreshing yet slightly woody scent.

products.title: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is a classy, modern unisex fragrance that feels warm, cozy, and stylish all at once. Inspired by the lively nights of Paris in the 1960s, Orphéon evokes memories of jazz bars, wooden furniture, and powdery notes reminiscent of soft skin and warm drinks.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh, slightly spicy touch of juniper berries, which feels crisp and clean. The heart of jasmine adds a gentle floral note that balances beautifully with the warm base of powder, cedarwood, and smooth tonka bean.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love fragrances that feel both fresh and comforting. This perfume feels like wearing a stylish blazer with a soft scarf, easy, elegant, and always inviting.

products.title: Lattafa The Kingdom Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa The Kingdom Eau de Parfum is a new aromatic perfume made for men who like fresh, sweet and warm scent all in one bottle. It opens with soft lavender, mint and sage that give a clean start. Then the scent turns a bit sweet and creamy with vanilla, tobacco and orange blossom in the heart. Later on, the warm base of tonka, benzoin, and labdanum comes in, making it smooth, sweet and a little bit smoky.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Tea Escape Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Tea Escape Eau de Toilette is a soft, calming and fresh women's perfume that feels like a peaceful tea break away from noise. The chilly mint, luminous bergamot and tiny pink pepper ignite the senses at the start. The central notes of green tea, soft jasmine and osmanthus add a subtle floral mood. At the end, you will find milk, rice and mate's warm and creamy mix, which gives the fragrance a cozy yet fresh aura. It is soft, soothing and very basic in a nice way.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern version of the classic Cool Water scent. It combines nature and strength with a clean, green and bold feel. The perfume starts with cool notes of galbanum and rosemary, giving a fresh and natural vibe. As it settles, Haitian vetiver adds a warm, earthy touch that feels smooth and lasting. Simple yet confident, this is the perfect perfume for men who like to feel refreshed, energetic and alive every day.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum is a woody aromatic fragrance designed for men who love deep and daring scents. It was launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin. The perfume starts with spicy pink pepper and is followed by the calming and fresh touch of lavender then dries down to a unique warm base of cacao. The mix gives a balance of spicy, floral and gourmand notes making it a modern perfume for men.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that was launched in 2022 this scent brings a confident balance of fresh spice, smooth leather and earthy wood. The fragrance opens with a spark of Mandarin Orange and black pepper giving a bright yet spice start and the middle with saffiano leather and suede adding a refined and daring tone and at the base Haitian Vetiver anchors the scent with depth and power. It is made for men who like to break limits and show their fearless side.

products.title: Ralph Lauren Polo Black Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Ralph Lauren Polo Black Eau de Toilette is a sophisticated and classy perfume for men that has a scent profile of fresh, woody, and subtly sweet. The fragrance starts off very clean and cool, feels modern and assertive. Over time, the woody notes grow more intense and warmer, imparting a refined and sophisticated character. The scent is reminiscent of luxury, peacefulness, and, of course, masculinity - it is ideal for men who appreciate the invisible power of very simple scents that can easily be the first choice of daily wear.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense For Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau Intense for women by Dolce & Gabbana boasts a refreshing Mediterranean summer character. It contains a citrus and green apple head note that transitions to soft, feminine floral notes resting on a warm, musky amberwood base. The perfume opens with lemon and Granny Smith apple, along with the heart note of jasmine and marigold, and rests on a gorgeous base of amberwood and musk. This is a bold and strong Eau De Parfum that lasts longer than earlier releases. Additionally, it offers versatility to wear every day, or as a complex fragrance, suitable for occasions that call for it.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Sailing Day Eau de Toilette is a fresh, unisex scent that feels clean, airy and a bit salty, like a morning by the sea. It opens with cool sea notes, aldehydes, coriander and a tiny hint of red pepper that gives a soft kick. The middle brings iris, juniper, rose and a fresh green vibe from amyl salicylate. The base settles into seaweed, ambergris, cedar and amberwood, which gives it a smooth, warm dry down, just like skin after a swim in the ocean.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette is a soft and clean perfume that smells like fresh sheets, warm sunlight and a slow, cozy morning. It is a soft and unisex aroma made up of lighthearted flowers, a little bit of pear, soft rose and iris in the middle and a velvety warm base of white musk, ambrette and a whisper of patchouli leaf.

products.title: Diptyque Doson Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Do Son Eau de Parfum is a luminous and elegant floral fragrance that captures the beauty of white‑flowers in full bloom. It opens with fresh touches of orange blossom and pink pepper that add a sparkling brightness, then evolves into rich tuberose and jasmine in the heart, and settles on warm musks and benzoin. It is created for both women and men who love refined, floral scents that feel both clean and seductive.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kaaf Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Kaaf Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2022 by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house as a fresh aquatic fragrance with a floral and fruity composition and a musky drydown. It has the top notes of red fruits, watermelon, lavender and Sicilian orange; a heart of sweet floral bouquet of lotus, jasmine, and lily of the valley; and a musky base with warm sandalwood and Ambroxan

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy, and elegant perfume made for women who love a sweet and warm scent. It starts with the gentle smell of rose milk, creating a smooth floral opening that feels cozy and romantic. The middle brings meringue and almond, adding a sweet, creamy note that feels like soft dessert air. The dry down is a mixture of vanilla, musk, and sandalwood that is serene, creamy, and slightly woody; thus, it is perfect for day and night.

products.title: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Teriaq Eau de Parfum is a new fragrance for men and women released in 2024. It is a sweet, warm fragrance that feels playful at first and then turns rich and deep as it settles. It opens with caramel, apricot, almond and a little pink pepper spark. In the heart you get honey, soft white flowers, rose and a touch of rhubarb. The base is warm and cozy with leather, vanilla, labdanum, musk and vetiver.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Oud is a bold and elegant men’s fragrance that combines rich oud wood with warm vanilla and soft lavender extract. It was launched in 2022. This scent is both modern and timeless, giving off strong masculine energy with a deep, smoky sweetness. It feels comforting yet powerful, perfect for men who like long-lasting, confident scents that leave an impression.

products.title: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Velvet Musk Eau de Parfum is a soft and clean unisex perfume that feels calm, smooth and cozy on skin. It starts off with white musk and a light touch of black tea, giving a fresh but warm start. The heart is a mixture of iris, which is powdery and sweet vanilla. The base consists of cedarwood, amber and coumarin, which result in a soft, woody and slightly sweet base that is very close to the skin.

products.title: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan 9PM Rebel Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume launched in 2024 by Afnan Perfumes. It was created by perfumer Gaël Montero it is a fruity-aromatic scent with a playful yet classy touch. The perfume opens with juicy pineapple, fresh green apple and sweet mandarin (top notes). The middle notes combine creamy vanilla, oakmoss and cedarwood for a smooth balance. Finally, the base leaves a warm trail of ambergris, dry woods, caramel and musk that lingers beautifully.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau de Parfum Intense is a daring and extravagant fragrance for women that exudes wealth and self-assurance. The scent first impresses with its fresh and vibrant lavender and citrus, which is slightly sweet, clean, and then gradually moves to the floral heart of jasmine, orchid, and orange blossom that seems to be elegant, modern, and floral at the same time. The vanilla, tonka bean, and ambergris base gives off a warm and deep aroma that lingers on the skin for a long time. This perfume is suited for women who are fond of strong, feminine, and alluring scents.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Intense Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a strong, fresh, and confident fragrance made for the modern man. This new version from the iconic Y collection brings more depth, intensity, and freshness than ever before. It opens with a burst of spicy ginger, fresh bergamot, and lively juniper berries. In the heart, you’ll find aromatic sage, soothing lavender, and elegant geranium, which add a masculine yet clean touch. The base is deep and woody with vetiver, patchouli, and cedar, giving long-lasting strength and warmth.

Y Eau de Parfum Intense Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for men who want to feel powerful, stylish, and ready to take on any challenge. One spray gives you freshness that lasts all day, whether you are in the office, at a party, or on a date night.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Untold Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex fragrance which wash launched in 2022 It is a combination of saffron and jasmine which are its top notes and followed by warm amberwood and ambergris in the middle notes and in the base notes with deep fir resin and cedar. The perfume carries a strong and long- lasting scent profile that makes it a favourite among fragrance lovers who enjoy a powerful yet smooth mix of spicy, woody and amber notes.

products.title: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 is a very sweet, fruity, and fresh perfume that is very bright from the first spray. The opening with juicy lychee, crisp red apple, and a tiny sparkle of lemon makes it very playful. In the middle, the soft violet, rose, and jasmine give a nice floral touch that is pleasant on skin. The dry down becomes warm and soothing with vanilla, sugar, musk, amber, sandalwood, and cedar.
