It is a cheerful, sugary, and girlish fragrance that is very suitable for daily use, informal occasions, and outdoor activities during the day.

products.title: Kayali Elixir 11 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Elixir 11 is a scent that is warm, deep, slightly sweet and feels bold right from the first spray. It is a fresh and soft sweet start, as the opening has rose petals mixed with juicy red apple touch. The heart has May rose and jasmine sambac in which the perfume smells floral, smooth, and a bit romantic. Later, patchouli, amber, and vanilla sink into the skin and give a rich, dark sweetness that lasts long. This fragrance is rich and confident, and it is ideal for those who love bold, sweet, floral perfumes.

products.title: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Goddess Intense Perfume for Women by Burberry is the brand’s standout oriental gourmand fragrance, launched in 2024. The scent has a rich and sweet aroma of a quartet of vanillas and lavender, making it perfect for those who love sophistication. The fragrance is also renowned for being a more intense interpretation of Burberry Goddess EDP, with the earthy accords giving it a more warmer, woodier and long-lasting profile.

products.title: Lattafa Ra'ed Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ra’ed Silver Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy unisex scent with a bright citrus opening and a deep, sweet, woody base. It starts with fresh hints of citruses, spices and mandarin orange, then moves into a rich heart of cinnamon, saffron, amber and cloves. The base settles into soft vanilla, musk, leather, oud and a touch of ambergris.

products.title: Afnan  Modest Une Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Modest Une Eau de Parfum is a modern men’s fragrance that was launched in 2019. It is an aromatic spicy combination made for men who like fresh, bold and long-lasting perfumes. The opening comes with sharp pepper, soothing lavender, cool mint and spicy nutmeg. The middle notes bring citrus, warm amber and refreshing eucalyptus. The base is masculine with musk, vetiver and cedarwood giving it depth and strength that stays for hours.

products.title: Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm, and dreamy fragrance made for women who love to feel soft and beautiful. Launched in 2024, this perfume brings together creamy vanilla with tropical coconut and delicious caramel for a scent that feels like a warm hug. The gentle touch of Palo Santo adds a hint of calm woodiness, while the base of white musk and sandalwood gives a smooth and cozy finish.

Souvenir Blooming Bliss Eau de Parfum is perfect for women who enjoy fragrances that are sweet yet elegant. Every spray wraps you in a blissful, creamy cloud that lasts for hours and keeps you feeling fresh and confident all day long.

products.title: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Olemeda Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume from the house of Afnan which was released in 2022. It is built around a fresh and spicy DNA with sparkling citrus, spices and woody accords. The perfume starts with grapefruit, pink pepper, juniper and cardamom, all are the top notes of this perfume. The middle notes are Calabrian bergamot, cedar, nutmeg and jasmine and the final notes are ambergris, apple, musk and patchouli for a deep long-lasting impression. This fragrance is designed as a versatile everyday signature with a balance of fresh energy and warm sensuality.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Collectors Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is a modern, fresh, and classy men’s fragrance that brings confidence with every spray. Inspired by timeless elegance, this scent mixes fruity freshness with warm woody notes, making it perfect for the man who wants to stand out.

The first spray greets you with a burst of juicy pineapple, crisp apple, and fresh bergamot balanced with delicate white flowers. As it settles, you’ll notice the heart of orange blossom, smooth birch, and warm amber adding depth and richness. The dry-down is where Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum shines earthy oak moss, clean musk, and unique ambergris, leaving a long-lasting, masculine trail that people won’t forget.

Whether you’re dressing up for a special event or adding a touch of class to your daily look, Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is your perfect companion.

products.title: Diptyque Boise Corse Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Bois Corsé by Diptyque is a rich and textured scent that captures the feeling of tree bark, roasted coffee, deep woods and warm tonka bean. It opens with bold aromatic coffee notes, then moves into creamy sandalwood, and finally settles into tonka bean and warm woods. The idea behind it is nature in its rawest form — rough bark, deep forests, warming woods. It’s a unisex fragrance that works best when you want something strong, bold, and a little mysterious.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum is an exquisite combination of sweetness, class, and confidence, which is the perfect fit for women who desire to be in the limelight. The fragrance starts with a mixture of delicious raspberry and sparkling lemon that is so fresh and cheerful. Then the gentle white flowers such as jasmine and orange blossom appear and add a rich, feminine note. The honey and patchouli support the fragrance as warm, soft, and very enduring on the skin. The scent is sophisticated, daring, and very attractive.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is made for women who love to feel confident and glamorous, and it was launched in 2005. This perfume combines fruity, floral and woody notes into a smooth and sensual composition. It opens with juicy pomegranate, sweet persimmon and a green accord. The middle notes bloom with exotic black orchid, lotus and champaca. Finally the base settles into warm mahogany, amber, black violet and creamy whipped notes.

Winner of the FiFi Award Fragrance of the Year Women’s Luxe 2006 Euphoria is one of the most popular perfumes from Calvin Klein known for its long-lasting performance and sensual appeal.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a lively and charming fragrance for women. Launched in 2021, it has a playful and bold scent profile made from fresh, fruity, and floral notes. The top notes of litchi and red currant give it a sweet and juicy start, the heart of rose adds a delicate floral touch, and the base of vanilla and vetiver gives a warm and elegant finish. Very Good Girl is perfect for confident women who want a mix of fun and sophistication in one fragrance.

products.title: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Cherry Smoke Eau de Parfum is a bold, dark and seductive unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Launched in 2022, this scent is all about deep cherry mixed with smoke and leather. It opens with a rich sour cherry note touched with saffron, giving a slightly sweet but spicy feel. The heart feels warm and smooth with leather, olive, osmanthus and apricot, adding depth and richness. The base turns smoky and woody with nagarmotha, making it intense, mysterious and long lasting.

products.title: Neesh Tobacco Vanilla Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Tobacco Vanilla Extrait De Parfum is a rich and warm unisex fragrance made for people who love deep and sweet scents. The opening notes are spicy and sweet at the same time, which, besides being bold, are also smooth. The tobacco, which is the strongest note, is very much pronounced in the middle and gives a cozy and classy feeling. The base is sweet and creamy vanilla combined with soft resin and tonka, which results in a long lasting and soothing fragrance.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Blue Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Blue Oud Eau de Parfum is a deep and strong fragrance that combines rich oud with soft floral notes. It starts with a smooth combination of oud and blue lilies, giving a fresh yet dark feeling. The middle becomes warm with leather and patchouli, adding a bold touch. In the last, you get sweet amber and smoky tobacco, which make the scent feel cosy, elegant, and long-lasting. It is a beautiful combination of luxury and softness, suitable for both men and women.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Tous Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and creamy women’s perfume that feels bright and warm at the same time. It opens with juicy mango, soft coconut and a little passionfruit that gives a tropical feeling. The heart brings jasmine, orange blossom and heliotrope, making it floral and soft. The dry down settles into a sweet and cozy mix of vanilla, musk and cashmeran that stays on skin like a warm hug.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fun and playful perfume made for women who love soft, fruity scents with a candy twist. The opening provides a delightful blend of black currant and green tangerine, which is a very juicy one. A pop of sweet strawberry fizz combined with a pale floral gardenia note resides in the heart. The final stage of the perfume is warm and creamy, with notes of vanilla, musk, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Vintage Radio Eau de Parfum is an unisex scent that can be characterized as warm oriental-woody with an opening that is soft, smoky and fresh. It starts with lavender, sage, and bergamot on the top, goes into a dark and sweet mixture of plum, palo santo, and black pepper in the heart and finishes with a smooth base of sandalwood and oud.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Narciso Rodriguez Vetiver Musc Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and earthy men’s perfume. The perfume was launched in 2024, and it gives off a natural and calming scent, however, it is still very masculine. First, it opens with green and spicy notes, then it moves to a soft musky heart and finally, it sinks into a woody base that feels smooth and lasts for a long time.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, classy, and mysterious fragrance for men and women who love bold and spicy scents. This perfume opens with a fresh touch of bergamot, violet, and spruce that adds a green, crisp feel. As the scent settles, you get warm notes of leather, pine tree, and lavender, which bring a smooth, deep vibe. The base of patchouli and labdanum adds richness and makes this fragrance last long.

Afnan Supremacy Noir Eau de Parfum feels powerful yet elegant, perfect for evening wear, parties, or when you want to feel confident and stylish. It leaves a warm, spicy trail that gets you compliments wherever you go.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold, and luxurious unisex fragrance that blends rich spices with smooth oud and sweet undertones. Launched in 2021, Supremacy in Oud quickly became popular for its exotic vibe and modern twist on classic oriental scents.

The first spray of Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum brings a burst of spicy saffron and nutmeg, balanced with calming lavender. The heart reveals deep agarwood (oud) mixed with sweet notes that add a smooth, comforting layer. The dry down is warm and long-lasting with earthy patchouli and soft musk, giving this perfume a rich, lasting finish.

Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love powerful, spicy, and woody scents that make them stand out wherever they go.

products.title: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raghba for Man Eau de Parfum is a warm, fresh and slightly sweet men’s perfume from the house of Lattafa. It opens with bright lemon and soft iris, giving a clean and crisp feel. After that, the perfume is the green, somewhat powdery heart of violet leaf. The end is sweet and manly with sandalwood, leather, ambergris and cedar.

products.title: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Raaed Luxe Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and spicy fragrance for men and women that opens with juicy fruits and fresh florals. It blends watermelon, pineapple, pink pepper and jasmine at the top. The middle brings herbal notes, soft lavender, sage and a light touch of cinnamon. The dry down becomes cozy with vanilla, musk, sandalwood, chestnut, vetiver, strawberry and tonka bean.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and bold unisex perfume. It has a deep oriental-woody feel with a sweet top and smoky base. The scent opens with pineapple and saffron, then moves into balsam fir and soft jasmine in the heart. The dry-down is thick, warm and long-lasting with cedar, amber and oud.

products.title: Versace Pour Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Pour Homme Eau de Toilette is a refreshing and pure fragrance for men that feels very light, soft, and comfortable on the skin. The opening note consists of a fresh citrus that is very vivid and uplifting. Gradually, the scent becomes aromatic and gentle with a clean woody character. This scent is uncomplicated, elegant, and ideal for everyday use. It is for those men who appreciate a subtle scent that is always fresh, soothing, and contemporary yet never overstated or oppressive.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Phantom Parfum is one of the most up-to-date and daring perfumes created for men's self-assurance. The initial impressions are of purity and vigor felt through the fresh and spicy notes. Gradually, the sweetness of lavender and earthiness of wood mingle to exude a gentle and tranquil aura. The final stage is warm, sugary, and faintly milky owing to the presence of vanilla and Balsam. This fragrance is interpreted as trendy, manly, and very persistent, an ideal match for the strong but soft perfume lovers.

products.title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the green spirit of nature with a luxurious twist. Unlike traditional vetiver scents that use only the root, Creed uses the entire vetiver plant, leaves, roots, and heartwood, resulting in a smooth, earthy, and uplifting scent.

This unisex fragrance feels elegant yet sporty, perfect for people who love refreshing yet long-lasting perfumes. It opens with a crisp green burst and gradually melts into warm, woody softness. Creed Original Vetiver is ideal for anyone who wants to smell fresh, refined, and put-together throughout the day.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Nouveau Monde Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Nouveau Monde Eau de Parfum is a warm and rich oriental scent created by Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud. It combines dark oud, smooth leather, sweet cacao and soft spices in a very smooth way. The fragrance feels deep, comforting and a bit bold, with a sweet-smoky tone that stays close to the skin after some hours.

products.title: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Nebras Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and cozy unisex scent that feels like a creamy vanilla dessert with a soft fruity touch on top. It opens with juicy red berries and a fresh mandarin orange. In the middle the main characters are smooth vanilla, cacao with a trace of soft rose. With the last notes of sugar, tonka bean amber, and clean musk make the base turn warm and welcoming.

products.title: Hugo Boss Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hugo Boss Man is a fresh and easy-to-wear perfume with a clean, green, and woody smell. It starts with a crisp green apple note that feels bright and youthful, then moves into a soft lavender heart that gives a calm and smooth vibe. The dry down is warm and woody with pine, balsam fir, and soft woody notes which stay gentle on skin. It is a simple and modern scent for men who like fresh daily perfumes without heavy sweetness.

products.title: Diptyque Lilyphea Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Lilyphea is a fragrance that evokes the peaceful feel of a water‑lily pond at dawn. With violet leaf creating a fresh green shimmer, the gentle spice of cardamom and ginger adds lift, and the soft warmth of bourbon vanilla provides comfort and elegance. The result is subtle yet refined, a nature‑inspired scent that feels serene and modern. According to Diptyque, the fragrance captures the spirit of the water lily leaf — crisp, sap‑filled, soft.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flower & Flames Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Libre Flowers & Flames by Yves Saint Laurent is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Libre Flowers & Flames was launched in 2024. Top notes are Lavender and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Lavender, Coconut, Lily and Palm Tree; base note is Vanilla.

products.title: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Liam Grey Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern unisex fragrance that brings together warmth and freshness in a very balanced way. Launched in 2023, it’s a mix of spicy cardamom, sweet fig and rich black tea at the top. The heart opens with soft iris, vetiver and labdanum, giving a smooth and deep texture. The dry down is warm and creamy with vanilla, sandalwood, tonka and patchouli. It feels elegant and calm, perfect for daily wear or evening outings.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Paradise Garden Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Beau Paradise Garden EDP is a sunny, beachy scent that combines fresh green and watery opening with a creamy coconut heart and a warm, woody base. It gives a relaxed, tropical feel, like a sea breeze and warm sand. It’s playful, easy to wear, and made for casual days and beachy evenings.

products.title: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum is a soft, earthy floral fragrance inspired by Japanese culture and Ikebana, the art of flower arranging. Created by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, it blends the fresh, slightly sweet aroma of Turkish rose with earthy beetroot and deep smoky vetiver, balanced with a layer of incense. It's a calm, minimal, and artistic scent almost meditative in its personality, perfect for those who enjoy quiet elegance and nature-inspired perfumes.

products.title: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume that gives a bold and confident vibe. Launched in 2023 by the house of Lattafa, it brings a fresh and spicy mix that feels both clean and deep. The perfume opens with juicy apple, spicy cardamom and fresh bergamot. The middle notes brings in warm tobacco, lavender and floral geranium. The dry-down is rich with tonka bean, leather, vetiver and patchouli.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Silver Eau de Parfum is a smooth, classy unisex scent from the famous Arabic brand Lattafa. It opens with a bright and zesty start of lemon and bergamot, mixing beautifully with a juicy pineapple and a spicy touch of black pepper in the middle. As it settles, warm base notes of vanilla, amberwood, cedar and patchouli take over, giving it a rich, deep and cozy finish.

products.title: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ishq Al Shuyukh Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich, warm and creamy scent for both men and women. Starting with a golden soft and sweet mix of caramel and saffron, the heart contains suede, leather and tonka bean which smooth out the scent and give it depth. The vanilla, amber and musk in the base provide a long-lasting warm and pleasant trail.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Invictus Parfum is an invigorating, sleek, and masculine perfume that radiates modernity and self-assurance. The scent starts off with a combination of icy oceanic notes, lavender and pink pepper, producing a fresh and subtly spicy introduction. The heart is very clean and has a soapy aspect due to the gentle green notes, whereas the base gets cosy and silky with the blend of musk, cashmere, and sandalwood. The fragrance is, in a way, athletic, powerful, and suited for day-to-day use.

products.title: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep scent for men. It’s a warm oriental-woody perfume that mixes spicy, sweet and smoky tones beautifully. The fragrance opens with cinnamon, lavender and mandarin for a spicy-fresh start. The middle brings soft iris, cypress, benzoin and floral mahonial. The base settles into creamy vanilla, tonka, amber, incense, cedarwood and patchouli giving a rich and warm trail.

products.title: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum is a new and charming perfume for women launched in 2024 by Lattafa. It is a warm, feminine scent that blends floral, sweet and musky notes beautifully. The perfume starts with a fiery touch of Mystikal and Cinnamon, then goes to a soft floral heart composed of Tuberose, Jasmine, Incense, and Mahonial. The perfume takes a smooth fall into a base of Vanilla, Musk, and Tonka thereby developing a creamy and cozy finish that is both elegant and modern at the same time.

products.title: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum is a charming and classy scent made for women who like something soft yet fresh. It opens with a sweet fruity sparkle of strawberry, champagne and tangerine, mixed with a hint of blood orange and rose. The middle of the perfume is made of gardenia, jasmine and vanilla orchid that provide a smooth floral note. The cozy finish is created by warm amber, sandalwood and chestnut in the base note, which also makes it close to the skin.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme is the perfume that you might love if you are into stylish perfumes. The fragrance starts with gentle violet, mandora, and a hint of fresh bergamot. The middle notes are creamy with wisteria, rose, and osmanthus. The base notes are soft and smooth with tonka bean, vanilla, and patchouli. This is a daring and comforting perfume designed for women who enjoy sweet, creamy florals along with a little warmth for evening and cooler weather.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum is a dreamy, modern floral perfume designed for the confident woman who loves sweetness with a touch of freshness. Inspired by the beauty of the exotic vanilla orchid, this fragrance mixes delicious vanilla with soft floral notes and a light, airy finish.

Wearing Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid feels like stepping into a magical garden filled with blooming orchids and a sweet breeze. It’s elegant, youthful, and perfect for women who want to feel fresh yet luxurious every day.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a joyful, dreamy, and fresh fragrance for women who love to feel confident, young, and free-spirited. This new perfume is inspired by the beauty of blooming magnolia flowers, mixed with fruity and creamy touches that make you feel happy from the first spray.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia is playful yet elegant. The top notes bring juicy dewberry, soft coconut, and a splash of fresh orange. The heart is full of magnolia petals, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, and lily of the valley, giving a lovely floral touch. In the base, warm musk, patchouli, and blonde woods make Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia long-lasting and soft.

This fragrance is for women who want to stand out sweetly and freshly, whether at work, on a date, or at a special event. One spray of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum can lift your mood and add a touch of floral magic to your day.

products.title: Louis Vuitton California Dreams Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton California Dreams Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy citrus fragrance made for people who enjoy a fresh, clean, and warm scent. It opens with a bright mandarin orange that feels like a sunny day, followed by a soft mix of pear and ambrette that adds a sweet-musky touch. As it dries down, gentle musk and benzoin create a warm and cozy base, giving the fragrance a simple but beautiful glow that feels like a sunset at the beach.

products.title: Tom Ford Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Bitter Peach Eau de Parfum is a bold, juicy and sweet unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Launched in 2020, this scent opens with a rich blast of ripe peach mixed with blood orange and warm spices. As it settles, it turns boozy and slightly floral and later melts into a deep, creamy and sweet base.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Honor & Glory Eau de Parfum is a unisex Arabic perfume that combines creamy, spicy and woody notes into one smooth scent. The opening is a delightful combination of pineapple and creme brulee, which feels both sweet and warm. When it settles down, the middle reveals the spices of cinnamon, turmeric, black pepper, and the sweetness of benzoin, making a heart that is both spicy and cozy. The dry-down is soft and rich with the notes of vanilla, sandalwood, cashmeran, and moss, which give the perfume a permanent warmth.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Bourbon Eau de Parfum is a modern and wealthy oriental spicy perfume for men. The scent is warm, deep, and bold, and it is suitable for men who love strong and powerful scents. Lavender is fresh, mirabelle is juicy and pink pepper adds a small kick at the very beginning of the fragrance. The heart is cacao, nutmeg, and davana mixed; dark and rich, giving a sweet but spicy feel. The dry down consists of vanilla, amber, and vetiver which are smooth and thick thus making it creamy, manly, and comforting at the same time.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental floral perfume designed for women who love warm and sweet scents. The perfume opens with a soft and fruity mixture of Mandarin Orange and Pear, then the heart of Jasmine, Rose, and sweet notes wrap the fragrance giving it a smooth and creamy touch. The base is Vanilla, Musk, and Raspberry that impart a warm sweetness which is very beautifully intimate with the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Nashma Caprice Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. Its launch in 2024 revealed the mixture of spicy, citrus, and woody notes in a fresh and elegant perfume. The composition starts with the lively cardamom, ginger, bergamot, and lemon that serve the energetic and clean opening. Lavender, geranium, and mint form the middle, with their soft, herbal, and calming touch added to the composition. The base is composed of amber, cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver that create a warm and smooth long-lasting dry down on skin.

products.title: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait De Parfum is a soft, rich and elegant rose-based perfume made for women who truly love floral scents. It opens with a fresh and bright rose mixed with citrus fruits, which feels clean and uplifting. As the scent settles, it becomes more floral and smooth with jasmine and lily adding a gentle sweetness. With deep warmth, the base remains and continues with the scent of earth, resin and woody notes that linger on the skin for hours.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Scandal Le Parfum is a bold and warm men’s fragrance that feels creamy and sweet. The first impression is a crispy geranium that adds a clean, slightly green touch, and then gradually it is a deep tonka bean heart that is sweet, smooth, and comforting. The sandalwood base provides a long-lasting soft woodiness that clings to the skin for hours. This fragrance represents manliness, strength, and modernity, and it is ideal for men who enjoy sweet and bold perfumes.

products.title: Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the confident man’s secret weapon for evenings. Designed for the man who knows how to own the night, this fragrance combines fresh aromatic notes with a smooth woody base that leaves a lasting impression.

It opens with crisp lavender and fresh birch, giving an energetic yet refined feel. The heart reveals soft violet, adding elegance and charm. Finally, deep woody notes and musk create a warm, masculine base that lingers till late.

Boss Bottled Night Eau de Toilette is the perfect scent for dinner dates, evening parties, or any time you want to look and feel powerful. One spray can instantly make you feel more attractive and self-assured.

products.title: Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold, magnetic, and modern fragrance for men who want to make a lasting impression. As the most intense version in the Boss Bottled line, this scent takes the iconic DNA and turns it into a richer, deeper, and more luxurious experience.

From the very first spray, Boss Bottled Elixir feels powerful yet smooth opening with the spicy freshness of cardamom and the smoky elegance of frankincense. As it develops, earthy patchouli and vetiver step in, adding depth and masculinity. Finally, warm labdanum and dry cedarwood create a strong, long-lasting base that feels sophisticated and confident.

This is not just a fragrance, Boss Bottled Elixir is a statement of strength and charisma. Whether for an important meeting, a date night, or a grand celebration, this scent makes sure all eyes are on you.

products.title: Hermes H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The new fragrance Hermes H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum for men is fresh, green, and a little fruity. It is a clean and contemporary scent that starts with sharp herbal notes reminiscent of fresh-cut greens after rainstorms. After, the soft pear note enters, contributing to the mild sweetness which makes the scent feel natural and soft. Physcool is part of the base, providing a cool, airy, almost mint-like effect that is very close to the skin. It is a straightforward, refreshing, and exhilarating fragrance for daily wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Babycat is an audacious and hot scent with a warm and rich feeling. The fresh hit of black and pink pepper at the start gives a sharp and vivid beginning, then gradually transitions into the heart of saffron and olibanum that is deep and slightly sweet. The bourbon vanilla, suede, and cedar base offer a gentle, persistent woodiness that remains on the skin for hours. This fragrance is in the manner of a modern and strong character, totally suitable for the ones who enjoy spicy and luxury scents.

products.title: Hermes Terre d'Hermes Parfum
products.body_html: Hermes Terre d’Hermes Parfum is a deep, warm, and earthy men's fragrance that feels classy and clean at the same time. It opens with bright orange and grapefruit that smell fresh and crisp, then slowly moves into the mineral-like flint note, which adds a sharp, masculine edge. The dry down is cosy with woodsy notes, oakmoss, and benzoin that give a smooth, rich, and slightly sweet finish. It is a confident and timeless scent that many men love for everyday and special moments.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum is a modern, romantic, and dazzling fragrance that feels like a passionate love affair in the city of Paris. It captures the intense feeling of falling in love. This beautiful scent opens with a sweet and juicy burst of red berries and pear, instantly making you feel happy and amazing. It then settles into a lovely heart of white flowers, creating a truly feminine and charming experience.

Mon Paris is for the woman who is passionate, modern, and lives freely. It is a perfect combination of sweet, floral, and warm notes that makes it incredibly easy to wear and love. One spray of Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris will envelop you in a beautiful aura of romance and elegance, making every moment feel truly special.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Marj Eau de Parfum is a unisex floriental fragrance by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house launched in 2023. It is a beautiful and graceful balance of numerous scent notes, which could have given messy results without fine blending. Marj has oud, honey, pink pepper, elemi, nutmeg, bergamot, and mandarin for its top layer; jasmine, cashmere wood, vetiver, orange blossom, cinnamon, patchouli, and saffron for the heart; and musk, ambergris, raspberry, oakmoss, saffron, pear, amber, agarwood, sandalwood, leather, and violet for the base of the composition.

products.title: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum is a bold leather perfume for men launched in 2020 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It carries a strong masculine edge with an elegant combination of spicy, floral, woody and smoky accords. The opening is sharp and intense with leather, violet leaf, nutmeg and cinnamon. The middle brings floral tones of violet and rose combined with deep oud and cedar wood. The dry down is warm, earthy and rich with vetiver, sandalwood and amber giving it a timeless Arabic touch.

products.title: Amouage Jubilation XXV Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Jubilation XXV Man is not just a perfume; it's a statement of royalty, celebration, and timeless elegance.Crafted for the man who is a king in his own right, this fragrance is a true masterpiece of modern perfumery. Imagine stepping into a grand palace, filled with the rich aroma of sweet incense, exotic spices, and precious woods. That is the experience of Jubilation XXV.

This scent is incredibly rich, complex, and majestic. It captures a feeling of pure happiness and achievement, making it the perfect scent for life's biggest moments. A spray of Amouage Jubilation XXV Man feels like wearing a crown; it’s confident, luxurious, and unforgettable.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette Intense is a classy and alluring scent specifically for the contemporary man who appreciates being bold with a little gentle touch. The fragrance starts off with a combination of cardamom, basil, and bergamot that is both bright and classy. The middle of perfume contains a soft and delicate scent of iris flowers together with a fresh and clean scent of cypress, which contributes to the overall smoothness and purity. The warm and soothing finish of cedar and coumarin forms the base of the fragrance which is at the same time soft and detectable. This perfume is a beautiful fusion of power and elegance; thus, it can be worn either in the daytime or for a quiet night out.

products.title: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Cologne Sophistique Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, clean and classy men’s perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent is made for men who like a neat, modern and confident smell. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel fresh and energizing, then slowly moves into soft florals and green tones. Smooth, warm and slightly creamy with woods, musk and vanilla is the base, which gives a polished touch but at the same time is suitable for everyday wear.

products.title: Creed Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Silver Mountain Water EDP is a fresh and clean fragrance for men and women. It opens with bright and sparkling top notes of bergamot and mandarin orange. The middle notes gives a refreshing green tea and black currant feel, soft and calming. The base adds depth with musk, sandalwood, petitgrain, and galbanum giving it a smooth and lasting scent. It is loved for being light, elegant, and easy to wear daily while still feeling special and luxurious.

products.title: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: BDK Citrus Riviera Eau de Parfum is a fresh unisex perfume from the French perfume house BDK Parfums which was launched in 2020 this fragrance is made by perfumer Ralf Schewieger and captures the joy of the Mediterranean summers. It opens with Italian lemon, neroli, Italian mandarin and fig that give a juicy citrus and the middle notes bring green notes, watery touches, eucalyptus, orange blossom, strawberry, immortelle and jasmine which together feel airy and refreshing. The base is warm and grounding with Haitian vetiver, white musk, tonka bean and Indonesian patchouli leaf making it a smooth combination of fresh and woody accords.

products.title: Hermes H24 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Hermes H24 Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern, and clean scent made for the man who enjoys soft green notes with a classy twist. It opens with bright lemon verbena and basil, giving a crisp, airy feeling. The middle brings gentle jasmine mixed with coriander, adding a soft floral touch with spices. The base of fir gives a warm, woody tone that makes the fragrance feel calm, uplifting, and very natural. It is a simple but elegant scent that works great for daily use.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Elixir Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Elixir Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a warm, rich, and spicy men’s perfume that feels bold but still smooth on skin. It opens with a mix of orange blossom, nutmeg, and spicy pimento seeds, then it goes soft with orris, osmanthus, and more orange blossom in the heart. In the dry-down, the scent becomes sweet, deep, and creamy with vanilla, ambrofix, benzoin, and patchouli. It is a modern, strong, and confident fragrance for men who like warm woody perfumes with a soft sweet touch.

products.title: Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Queen of Silk Eau De Parfum is a royal and modern unisex fragrance that feels soft like silk but smells rich like gold. Inspired by the flowing Silk Roads of the East and the luxurious fashion of royalty, this perfume blends fruity sweetness, creamy florals, and soft woody notes in a way that feels timeless yet modern.

The opening feels bright and slightly juicy, thanks to saffron and magnolia, while the heart brings a creamy floral touch with tuberose and passionfruit. As it dries down, the base becomes smooth, woody, and slightly warm with oud, ambroxan, and Madagascar vanilla, giving Creed Queen of Silk its signature rich elegance.

This fragrance is made for those who love luxury but with a soft and graceful personality. Whether you’re dressing up for a wedding or want to feel special every day, Creed Queen of Silk adds charm, softness, and sophistication to your presence.

products.title: Louis Vuitton L'Immensite Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton L’Immensité Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s perfume made for daily wear. It opens with bright citrus and ginger that feels cool and light on the skin. Then the scent moves into watery and herbal notes like rosemary, sage and soft geranium. The dry down turns warm and comforting with ambroxan, amber and a bit of labdanum, giving a soft skin-like finish.

products.title: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nasomatto Black Afgano Extrait de Parfum is a bold, dark and deep unisex perfume from the house of Nasomatto. This fragrance is known for its intense woody and smoky feel with a rich and mysterious character. It opens with strong green and herbal notes mixed with a dark earthy touch, slowly moving into warm resins, coffee and tobacco. The base is heavy, long lasting and very strong with a powerful mix of oud, incense, amber and musky notes that stay on the skin for hours.

products.title: Roja Parfums Enigma Pour Homme
products.body_html: Roja Parfums Enigma Pour Homme is a rich, warm and classy men’s fragrance created by Roja Dove. Enigma Pour Homme was a perfume that was introduced in the year 2019. It starts with a citrusy and fresh presentation of bergamot, then the scent develops into soft flowers with a hint of spices. The finale is thick, boozy and sweet, comprising cognac, tobacco, vanilla and amber notes.

products.title: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Energy Eau de Parfum, a fresh and powerful fragrance for men, is a perfect choice for those who want to stay bright, clean, and lively. The fragrance starts with a strong and very fresh burst of citrus notes that are really energizing. Gradually, it goes to a spicy and slightly sweet heart that provides depth and balance. The base is woody and musky, resulting in a smooth and long-lasting finish. This scent is modern, confident, and bold, absolutely perfect for men who prefer fresh but strong perfumes.

products.title: Creed Aventus Absolu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Aventus Absolu Eau De Parfum is the boldest, freshest version of the iconic Aventus ever made. It’s a limited-edition fragrance that turns up the volume on the signature Creed DNA making it fruitier, fresher, and even more irresistible. Designed for the man who owns the room with confidence and class, Creed Aventus Absolu blends the juicy brightness of grapefruit and blackcurrant with a refined woody base. The result? A modern, luxurious fragrance that smells powerful, clean, and classy at the same time.

Creed Aventus Absolu is all about making a statement whether you’re heading to a high-profile meeting, a wedding, or just want to feel elite. Every spray feels rich, fresh, and uplifting perfect for Indian men who appreciate sharp, long-lasting luxury.

products.title: Serge Lutens Ambre Sultane Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Serge Lutens Ambre Sultan Eau de Parfum is a rich and deep amber based fragrance made for people who love bold and warm scents. It has a strong resin and spice character that feels old school, royal and very creative. The fragrance opens with herbal and spicy notes and slowly turns warm, sweet and resinous on the skin. It feels intense, cozy and long lasting, perfect for those who enjoy classic niche perfumes with a strong personality.

products.title: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Fucking Fabulous Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich and very confident unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. It was revealed in 2017 and it is famous for the full bodied leather combined with the warm and creamy notes. It starts with the fresh and sweet scent of lavender and clary sage, which gives a pure but also an edgy beginning. The middle is very strong and very much like leather, burnt almond, vanilla and orris, holding the sweetness but still being powerful. The base remains long with leather, tonka bean, cashmeran, white woods and amber, creating a warm, sexy and lasting trail.

products.title: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Neroli Portofino Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and bright unisex fragrance from the luxury house of Tom Ford. Inspired by the Italian Riviera, this perfume feels like a cool sea breeze mixed with fresh citrus fruits and white flowers. It opens with sharp and juicy citrus notes blended with soft herbs, then moves into smooth neroli and orange flower and finally settles into a light musky and amber base.

products.title: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html: Tom Ford Vanille Fatale Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is deep, warm, and very rich at the same time. It is also a unisex scent that can be worn by both women and men. The first impression is that of saffron and coriander, a combination of spices that feels daring and different. The aroma then progressively becomes more and more complex and rich with the addition of coffee and delicate white flowers. By the end, the vanilla is very strong and it blends with tobacco and woods which gives a smooth, sensual, and quite lasting finish. This scent is nothing short of being powerful, bold, and opulent.

products.title: Chopard Black Incense Malaki Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chopard Black Incense Malaki Eau De Parfum is a deep, smoky, and rich perfume made for both men and women. It was launched in 2020 and has a warm, mysterious scent that feels bold and elegant. The fragrance starts with spicy notes, then turns smooth with smoky resins and oud. In the end, it settles into a soft mix of leather and wood that lasts long and smells classy.

products.title: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Grey Vetiver Parfum is a new fragrance by the designer Tom Ford, which contains a clean, elegant and modern aura for men. It was released in 2023 with a new version that was deeper, richer and smoother than previous ones. The composition starts with a fresh, slightly floral note, followed by a spicy one and then the vetiver base with its strong earthy quality takes over.

products.title: Tom Ford Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vanilla Sex by Tom Ford is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vanilla Sex was launched in 2023. Top note is Bitter Almond; middle notes are Vanilla and Floral Notes; base notes are Vanilla Absolute, Ultravanil™, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

products.title: Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum is a daring and luxurious rose scent that is rich, spicy, and floral simultaneously. The perfume starts with a pungent blend of Sichuan pepper and turmeric, which is warm and mildly spicy. The heart, by and by, unfolds strong, deep, and at the same time fresher and from time to time romantic rose notes. The patchouli and tonka bean base gives the fragrance both profoundness and silky texture. This fragrance is self-assured, contemporary, and unisex, thus ideal for those who love roses.

products.title: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume that is fresh, elegant, and at the same time, light and confident. It begins with a sweet and juicy blend of pear and bergamot and a hint of pink pepper for a little sparkle. Soft and floral heart is characterized by rose and jasmine, providing a gentle womanly feeling. The background is warm and smooth formed of white musk, vanilla, patchouli, and cedar that cling to the skin for hours. This perfume is modern, fresh, and ideal for women who appreciate clean, soft, and long-lasting fragrances.

products.title: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme
products.body_html: Roja Parfums Elysium Pour Homme Parfum Cologne is a fresh, clean and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Roja Parfums. The fragrance shines with its top note of vibrant citruses that impart an energetic and contemporary feel. The middle note reveals a combination of green, fruity and lightly spicy scents that embody smoothness and confidence. The warm, velvety and slightly buttery base of the concoction contributes a richness and longevity, thus making it hard to miss and very alluring. It smells elegant, masculine and very uplifting, perfect for men who like fresh but premium perfumes.

products.title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and timeless fragrance that captures the spirit of coastal luxury and warm sunshine. Created by the House of Creed in 1995, this iconic scent is loved by both men and women for its clean, citrusy freshness with a smooth musky finish.

Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruits and sea breeze, making you feel like you’re walking along a royal Mediterranean coast. As it develops, warm woods and musk add depth and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who want a scent that’s both refreshing and classy.

Creed Millésime Impérial is a fragrance that fits every season and every occasion. Whether it’s a sunny day, a romantic evening, or a formal event, this perfume makes you feel confident, clean, and irresistible.

products.title: Premium Vegan Leather Travel Case
products.body_html: Elevate your fragrance experience on the go with our luxurious vegan leather travel case. Designed with precision and style, it features 4 slots to securely hold atomizers along with 6 additional refill slots - 3 each for 5ml & 10ml refills. The soft inner lining ensures your vials stay protected, while the sleek foldable design with snap-button closure makes it perfect for travel or gifting. A must-have for fragrance lovers who value elegance and practicality!

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Creed Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Green Irish Tweed EDT for men was launched in 1985 in France by Creed Boutique—a renowned fragrance house in high society. It is a fine blend of fresh green aromas that adds a timeless, sophisticated, and charismatic gentleman vibe to the masculine energy. It gives a clean and polished depth with its aromatic fougère DNA and soft natural notes of iris, vervain, violet leaves, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tres Nuit Eau de Parfum is a fresh and spicy scent made specially for men. It opens bright with lemon, iris, and vervain, giving a citrusy and green start. The middle notes move into lavender, violet, and some spicy touches that make it elegant and smooth. At the base, ambergris and sandalwood bring depth and warmth, making it a timeless perfume that feels both clean and classy.

products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Qahwa Eau de Parfum is a sweet, spicy and creamy scent made for both men and women. This perfume brings together the cozy warmth of cinnamon and cardamom with the smooth sweetness of praline and vanilla. The mix of coffee and tonka bean gives it a deep, rich aroma that feels comforting yet classy. It’s a perfect scent for people who love strong, dessert like perfumes with a warm base that stays beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and comforting perfume that wraps you in a soft, cozy scent. Perfume for women, this scent feels like a warm dessert in a bottle. The aroma starts with the notes of caramel, milk and sugar, which create a smooth and creamy first impression. Then it changes to a floral and golden scent with honey and white flowers while the base floats away into vanilla, praline and musk.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Lovers Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Lovers Eau de Parfum is a fresh and modern woody aroma made for men who enjoy clean, warm and stylish scents. The fragrance begins with bright green galbanum and smooth bergamot and then moves to a warm blend of ginger and soft solar notes. The dry-down is made of creamy sandalwood and clean cedarwood, which gives the perfume a simple but classy character, a scent that is calm, light and easy to wear every day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Absolutely EDP is that cozy, confident scent you grab when you want to feel like the best version of yourself. It kicks off with a boozy rum splash mixed with bright bergamot and a resin kick from elemi, then slides into lavender and davana that smell clean yet a little wild. Chestnut, Madagascar vanilla, cedar, and patchouli wrap it up warm and woody, like a hug that lasts. Cecile Matton put this together in 2021, building on the Stronger With You line to say love is strong, stay true. Guys in the fragrance world love how it mixes sweet booze with fresh herbs, perfect for dates or nights out, with solid staying power and a trail that turns heads.

products.title: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Frederic Malle Musc Ravageur EDP is a bold, truly sensual choice. It works for everyone—men and women. The scent is famous for its warm, spicy, and deep musk feel. Maurice Roucel created Musc Ravageur in 2000. It opens with fresh energy. You first smell lavender, tangerine, and bergamot. That clean burst soon fades. The center quickly moves to a rich mix: cinnamon, cloves, and rose. This makes the perfume smooth. It gives a light, powdery touch. The base is where it locks down. Expect deep warmth here. Musk, vanilla, amber, and woods dominate. This strong finish makes Musc Ravageur unforgettable. It feels cozy; it feels mysterious. The scent is known for staying warm and strong on your skin all day.

products.title: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is a bold, powerful, and intense fragrance crafted especially for the modern gentleman. Launched in 2024, Bvlgari Man in Black parfum is a deeper and richer version of the original Man in Black line by Bvlgari. It opens with a smoky spice that immediately catches attention, followed by warm leather, deep resins, and creamy vanilla. This fragrance is designed for men who want to leave a lasting impression with a scent that feels both luxurious and masculine. Whether you’re heading to a formal evening or a winter brunch, Bvlgari Man in Black Parfum is your perfect statement fragrance.

products.title: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Penhaligon's Halfeti Leather Eau de Parfum is a powerful and mysterious leather scent that is unisex. The fragrance begins with a delicate combination of plum, cardamom, and fresh citrus that is warm and somewhat spicy. Gradually, rose, nutmeg, and cinnamon unfold revealing a profound and elegant character. At the end of the process, leather, oud, and incense remain robust and smoky. The impression received from this fragrance is dauntless, sumptuous and just right for self-assured perfume users.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Oud Eau de Parfum is a profound, shadowy, and mighty aroma that imparts richness and smokiness. At the top, a powerful whiskey accord is the major player, giving a daring and alcoholic accent first. Gradually, spicy resins like cinnamon and coriander join in and heat things up. When it comes to the base note, the combination of tobacco and oud with incense and different types of woods results in a thick and opulent scent. This fragrance is bold, strong, and sophisticated at the same time and is made for those who like strong and adult-like perfumes.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Silver Eau de Parfum is a clean, fresh and sharp fragrance for men & women that feels bright and confident. It opens with cold and crisp notes like juniper berries, nutmeg, bergamot and a small touch of pineapple that makes the start feel energetic. The heart brings coriander for a dry spicy tone, while the base settles into soft musk, woody notes, cedar, amber and a hint of vanilla.

products.title: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Xerjoff Alexandria II Eau de Parfum is a lavish and harmonious perfumery where the warm, woodsy, and subtly sugary notes dominate. The perfume opens with gentle lavender, apple, and cinnamon that create a neat and elegant beginning. Gradually, the fragrance proceeds to a floral and woody heart consisting of rose and cedar. During the dry down phase, the oud, sandalwood, vanilla, and amber feel deep, creamy, and very rich. The fragrance is a bait, calming and giving off a powerful aura. It is ideally suited for those who are fond of wearing strong niche scents.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Prive Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Privé is a men's fragrance that is sweet and spicy with a warm and rich touch. Its opening is spicy with cinnamon accompanied by the fruity note of blood mandarin which feels fresh but at the same time deep. Tobacco and myrrh slowly become part of the scent and give it a dark, soft, and elegant character. The dry down consists of tonka bean and patchouli, which combined, create a sweet woody finish that lingers on the skin and clothes for a long time. This perfume gives off an air of confidence, seductiveness, and is ideal for the night.

products.title: Tom Ford Ebene Fume Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ébène Fumé Eau de Parfum is a deep, smoky and woody unisex perfume from the luxury house of Tom Ford. The scent seems to be dark, warm and somewhat spiritual. It starts off with the overpowering sweetness of incense and palo santo, which still manages to create a soothing and smoky atmosphere of a temple. It then gradually transitions to the aroma of leather and soft flowers and then finally to the rich smell of wood and resins.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger with You Intensely Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Intensely EDP is the one you grab when you're head-over-heels and want the world to know. Starts with a sharp pink pepper snap, a whiff of juniper, and this powdery violet that sneaks in soft, then melts into toffee, cinnamon, lavender, and sage for a sweet-herbal swirl. Vanilla, amber, tonka bean, and suede close it out warm, leathery, and addictive. Dropped in 2019, it’s the bolder chapter in the Stronger With You story, all about young passion. We bet on the caramel-spice combo, cozy enough for cuddles, sexy enough to stop traffic, hangs around all night and leaves folks sniffing your collar.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Boisee Eau de Parfum for men is a warm, woody, and elegant scent that feels both modern and timeless. It opens with spicy black pepper, geranium, and coriander, giving a bold yet classy start. The middle reveals a touch of iris mixed with cacao pod and cedar, adding smoothness and depth. The dry down of woodsy notes, sandalwood, and patchouli gives a comforting and lasting impression.

products.title: Givenchy L'Interdit Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy L’Interdit Intense Eau de Parfum, a women's fragrance, is a daring and profound scent with a touch of spiciness and flowers. It starts with a potent black pepper aroma and then mixes with silky white flowers such as tuberose and orange blossom along with an extraordinary sesame fragrance. The base is cozy and sugary with a combination of vanilla from Madagascar, patchouli, and vetiver. This fragrance is perceived as extravagant, daring, and sophisticated, and it lasts on the skin for night and evening use. Its dark and graceful aroma that is strong and feminine is liked by many scent aficionados.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Delina is an irresistible, sophisticated, soft floral scent that belongs to the group of women who are fond of fresh and romantic perfumes. The opening is a vibrant, rather sweet and quite pleasant, juicy combination of litchi and rhubarb. With a beautiful Turkish rose accompanied by peony and soft musk, the heart is slowly revealing itself. The base is warm and smooth, composed of woods and incense, thus making the scent elegant and of good duration.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Black Eau De Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance made for the party spirit. Released in 2017, this scent mixes strong spicy, herbal and sweet notes into a modern aromatic fougere blend. The fragrance opens with absinthe, anise, and fennel for a sharp and spicy start. Lavender in the heart brings balance and freshness. In the base, black vanilla husk and musk add a dark, sensual touch that lasts long on the skin. It is daring, masculine and smooth perfect for evening events and night outs.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Silk Mood Eau De Parfum is a smooth, airy and elegant unisex perfume that combines soft floral notes with deep, dark oud. It opens with a fresh touch of bergamot and chamomile, then the middle is warm with guaiac wood and hedione, and finally, the base is rich with agarwood (oud) and papyrus.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Black Eau de Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Rasasi. Launched in 2024, this scent feels fresh, fruity and woody at the same time. It starts with delightful pineapple, vibrant bergamot and tangy grapefruit, which give a clean and energetic feeling. The middle of the fragrance already shows patchouli, cedar and a hint of jasmine, making the perfume slightly rich and slowly earthy. The strong and warm base is made up of oakmoss, woody notes and amber that linger on the skin for many hours.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Eau de Toilette is a fresh and strong men’s fragrance that feels clean, modern, and confident. It opens with a cool splash of bergamot, grapefruit, and watery notes that feel very fresh on skin. Slowly, it moves into a spicy and slightly woody heart with black pepper and ambroxan. The base feels warm and smooth with musk, incense, and tonka bean. This scent feels masculine, stylish, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Tobacco Vanille Eau de Parfum is a lavish, warm, and sweet fragrance suitable for both genders. The perfume starts with a bold tobacco leaf aroma blended with gentle spices that provide a luxurious and sophisticated feel. After a while, the creamy vanilla, cacao, and tonka bean add sweetness and smoothness to the scent. The woody and dried fruit notes remain on the skin for an extended period in the dry-down stage. This perfume exudes luxury, and daring, and is just right for those who appreciate the strong and warm scents.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum is a warm, spicy, and creamy men's fragrance that feels bold and classy from the first spray. It opens with creamy cardamom that gives a deep spicy kick, then the scent becomes smooth with lavender and soft iris in the centre. As it dries down, the warm vanilla, oriental notes, and woody touches create a cosy, sweet, and masculine finish. It is strong, long-lasting, and perfect for men who like a powerful but elegant fragrance.

products.title: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum is a masculine woody aromatic fragrance from the house of Armaf. It starts with a burst of citrus freshness from bergamot, pomelo, mandarin, orange and lemon and in the middle notes, a floral twist with lavender, geranium, tuberose and ylang-ylang then balances freshness with elegance. The final notes end in a warm and spicy trail of black pepper and cardamom, creating a bold yet smooth finish. This fragrance is designed for men who like energetic, confident and modern scents that last throughout the day.
